fields.title: How a jacket image reaches a page

sections.What this covers: The request path, the writers that fill the image container, and what a borrower sees when a leg of the path fails. The routes, the cache key and the container itself belong to the service records. Where the rest of the estate sits belongs to [exp-estate-overview](estate-overview.md).
sections.Where the detail lives:
* [svc-covers-cdn](../services/covers-cdn.md) describes the edge, its routes and its cache key.
* [svc-thumbnailer](../services/thumbnailer.md) describes the origin and the container it reads.
* [svc-catalogue-api](../services/catalogue-api.md) describes the gateway that writes staff uploads.
* [itg-bibliographic-data](../integrations/bibliographic-data.md) describes the supplier the nightly import takes its imagery from.
* [ofr-discovery](../offerings/discovery.md) lists what a borrower uses to find a title, and states that a title with no image shows a placeholder.
* [exp-estate-overview](estate-overview.md) puts this path beside the rest of the estate.
